tagline: Circle anything on screen: search, translate, ask AI, snip. Free, private, Windows and Linux
outcome: One key over any app gives search, in-place translation, an AI answer or a snip, offline first, with nothing leaving the PC unless the user asks.

users: People who search, translate or ask AI about what is on their screen
Players who want games translated in place
northStar.problem: Circle to Search and Lens are phone-first, online and tied to one company; desktop users get scattered tools.
nonGoals: No macOS until the owner has a Mac
constraints: Windows 10/11 and Linux (X11 + Wayland) from the first design
Offline by default; online only when the user chooses it
One native binary, light on RAM and CPU

waiting.recommended: Settings v2 + the app-wide look + the Snip widget per mode, one canvas round

releases.name: Snip recording + the new design
releases.why: Owner 2026-11-24: video and audio recording in Snip next, and the design he has not approved yet is finished right after the enhancements.
releases.outcome: Snip records an area, a window or the screen with microphone and/or computer sound; its widget changes with the mode (record mode shows record controls only, no picture tools); the new design is approved and applied.

items.title: Design stage 1: prototypes of the recording widgets + Open with (owner OK), then stage 2: all of Settings
Recording research: capability table Windows / X11 / Wayland (capture, mic, system audio, hardware encoder)
Recording design: the Snip widget per mode (picture tools only for pictures; record bar only for audio/video)
Audio foundations: microphone and system audio (#118)
Record video of an area / window / screen with sound (#168)
Record audio only
Blur zones in recordings (areas or a followed app window) (#225)
Snip full screen easier: scroll up over a window steps out to the whole screen (click takes it); clearer Enter = full screen hint
Snip toolbar: Long capture button on the main toolbar (out of More)
Snip toolbar: one Pin button (click = still pin); options row: Pin | Live pin (Live while in Labs)
Snip: right-click on the picked area = short menu (Copy, Save, Pin, Open in Studio, Copy text, Translate, Ask AI), same list as More; right-click mid-stroke cancels; shape menu later
Live pin click-through: hold Ctrl over the pin to make it clickable; faint mark + tooltip while clicks pass through; tray row stays

Snip: pick a picture/card on the page: boxes found in the frozen screenshot (+ system controls where available); hover stays the window, scroll down = smaller part, scroll up = bigger/screen; one-time hint. Lab test first (right box on image grids/news/game menus, < 5 ms per hover), built only if it works

Right-click menus v2b: Snip picked area (with R-11), recording corner thumbnail, translated text + translate pill, AI chat (selected answer text, a message, a picture chip, the composer); study docs/internal/reports-enh/w115-right-click-study.md

Tips: one-time contextual hints in widget style E + the 'What can I do?' card; each tip once per user, existing users included (first time the feature is relevant after the update); 'Don't show tips' in Settings
